source_evidence: some invest in all of the securities included in a market index, while others invest in only a sample of the securities included in a market index.
question: Misconception: Every index fund holds every security in the index it tracks.
answer: Not necessarily. A fund using full replication invests in all the index’s securities, while a fund using sampling invests in only some of them. A sampling fund may therefore be less likely to match the index’s performance exactly.
